-- Urinetown (2024) - musical satire
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Urinetown' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2024', 'Satire', 'Dystopian', 'Political Satire', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Barefoot in the Park (2024) - romantic comedy
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Barefoot in the Park' AND t.name IN ('Comedy', '2024', 'Romantic Comedy', 'Summer Stock', 'Neil Simon', 'New York City')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
